title: 7 Best HostBuddy AI Alternatives (2026)
summary: Compare 7 HostBuddy AI alternatives for vacation rentals in 2026: Akia, Besty, Conduit, Aeve, Guesty, Hospitable, and Hostaway on voice, tasks, and price.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated October 7, 2026.*


The best HostBuddy AI alternatives for vacation rentals in 2026 are Akia, Besty, Conduit, Aeve, Guesty, Hospitable, and Hostaway. Choose Akia, Besty, or Conduit to add phone AI and task management to guest messaging, Aeve for policy-locked replies on Guesty or Hostaway, and Guesty, Hospitable, or Hostaway if you want the AI built into your PMS.


## Why do hosts look for a HostBuddy AI alternative?


Hosts look for a HostBuddy AI alternative when they need more than an AI that answers guest messages. HostBuddy AI is a cautious autopilot that connects to the 14 property management systems listed in the[HostBuddy FAQ](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/faqs) , can be scheduled to cover only the hours your team is off, and flags anything the AI shouldn't handle alone through[Action Items](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/action-items) , such as maintenance issues, lockouts, cleaning complaints, and questions that need host approval.[HostBuddy says](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/) its top hosts see 95%+ AI automation rates.


HostBuddy's caution also explains its gaps. An Action Item tells you a guest's AC is broken, and then a person has to create the maintenance task, chase the technician, and tell the guest. HostBuddy's Journeys builder and upsells cover automated guest workflows, but a person still turns each Action Item into a task. It has no task module of its own and no published voice product, so phone calls and the operational follow-up stay with your team.


## How did we rank the HostBuddy alternatives?


I ranked the HostBuddy alternatives by how much of the guest-to-task loop each covers in one product, counting three things from the vendor's own pages: AI guest messaging, a published voice or phone AI, and task management for cleaning and maintenance. Ties are listed alphabetically, and Conduit, which is my company, sits where that count puts it.


The work rarely ends at the reply. A guest reports a leak, maintenance gets dispatched, and the guest needs to hear it's fixed. My post on why guest messaging and operations belong in one system shows where that loop breaks across separate tools.


## What are the best HostBuddy AI alternatives in 2026?


The seven HostBuddy AI alternatives below all automate guest messaging, and all seven also include some form of task management, which is the main thing HostBuddy leaves out. Each entry is limited to what the vendor publishes on its own site, with a link to the page I checked, and notes where a price or a feature is not published.


### 1. Akia


Akia runs guest messaging and the phone line from one AI. The[Akia home page](https://www.akia.com/) says "the same Akia that answers your messages runs your phone line", holding a conversation and taking payment before the call ends. Its Skills let you write a procedure in plain steps, and the published maintenance example files a task with the room and the issue, then messages the guest once the task is marked done. Akia says on its[guest messaging page](https://www.akia.com/agents/guest-messaging) that it connects to 20+ property management systems. Akia also sells a[vacation rental product](https://www.akia.com/solutions/vacation-rentals) that syncs with Escapia, Guesty, Streamline, Hostaway, OwnerRez, and Hostfully, although most of its published case studies are hotels. Pricing is not published. Our[Akia review](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/akia-review-pricing-alternatives) has the detail.


### 2. Besty AI


Besty pairs a confidence-gated autopilot with voice and an operations module.[Autopilot Messaging](https://www.getbesty.ai/features/autopilot-messaging) sends only when it's confident, drafts otherwise, and pauses when a guest sounds unhappy, which is close to how HostBuddy behaves. Besty adds an[AI Voice Receptionist](https://www.getbesty.ai/features/ai-voice-receptionist) , labelled Beta, built-in VoIP, and a[Cleaning & Ops](https://www.getbesty.ai/features/cleaning-ops) module with a field app and vendor task links. The[integrations page](https://www.getbesty.ai/integrations) lists 16 PMSs. Pricing is not published.


### 3. Conduit


Conduit runs configurable AI agents across messaging and voice, and its Full Suite package adds tasks, workforce, scheduling and dispatch, and inventory. Each agent gets its own instructions, model, guardrails, and a per-tool allowlist for every connection, runs in Autopilot or Copilot mode, and can be set differently per channel. Skills are named, versioned instruction packs attached to an agent.


Where HostBuddy raises an Action Item, a Conduit agent can call a deterministic workflow as a tool. The workflow creates the task with the guest's photos attached, dispatches a cleaner or contractor by SMS or email with accept and decline links, and waits. Task created, status changed, and task completed each fire a trigger that can message the guest, and workflows run on a durable runtime that retries failed steps. Automation runs at 70-90% of conversations across the platform, and[Haven Vacation Rentals](https://www.conduit.ai/customers/haven-2026) reached 90%. Pricing starts at $18 per unit per month. The trade-off is setup time. That depth takes configuring, and a host who only wants answers will start faster on HostBuddy.


### 4. Aeve


Aeve is built around policy enforcement for Guesty and Hostaway operators. The[product page](https://www.aeve.ai/product) describes replies that are "Safe, policy-locked", with anything outside your rules sent to a person with the conversation attached, which suits teams that chose HostBuddy for its caution. Aeve also schedules housekeeping, maintenance, and inspections, messages housekeeping on WhatsApp and maintenance by email, and writes reservation changes back to the PMS. No phone product is published.[Pricing](https://www.aeve.ai/pricing) is $12.80 per listing per month on a 12-month contract.


### 5. Guesty


Guesty fits when you already run Guesty as your PMS. Its[AI agents](https://www.guesty.com/features/ai-for-short-term-rentals/) include ReplyAI Autopilot for guest messages and a message-to-task dispatcher that turns issues in guest messages into operational tasks, which is the step HostBuddy leaves to your team. Task management is native to the PMS. No voice agent is listed, and pricing is not published on the page.


### 6. Hospitable


Hospitable is a PMS whose messaging focuses on tone and timing across Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking.com. Its[pricing page](https://hospitable.com/pricing) lists AI suggested replies, AI guest issue alerts, and fully automated messaging with Inbox AI on the Mogul plan, and every plan includes[Hospitable Tasks](https://hospitable.com/features/hospitable-tasks) for cleaning and maintenance sent by email, SMS, or iCal. There is no phone product on the pricing page, and the paid prices did not render when I checked. Our[Hospitable review](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/hospitable-review-pricing-alternatives) covers it in full.


### 7. Hostaway


Hostaway offers[AI replies and Auto-Reply](https://www.hostaway.com/features/hostaway-ai/) for the topics you choose, plus an automated Task Manager for cleaning, maintenance, and inspections. Hostaway's own claim is up to 90% of guest communication automated. The AI CoHost recommends next steps across the account. No AI voice is published. Hostaway says AI Replies comes with no add-on fee, but the PMS subscription price isn't published.

## Which HostBuddy alternatives include task management?


All seven HostBuddy alternatives on this list include task management, and HostBuddy does not. HostBuddy's Action Items list what needs doing by property and guest, and the[HostBuddy pricing page](https://www.hostbuddy.ai/pricing) describes a cohost scheduled around your team. Turning an Action Item into a dispatched job is still a person's work.


The difference among the other seven is how much of the loop runs without a person. Hospitable creates tasks from check-in and check-out events, and Hostaway's Task Manager routes cleaning and maintenance around reservations. Guesty's dispatcher and Akia's Skills create tasks from the guest's message. Akia's published maintenance Skill and Conduit's task triggers also close the return path, so the guest hears back when the job is marked done. In Conduit, a cleaner accepting a work order or a technician changing its status can trigger a message too. For the messaging side alone, see our[best AI guest messaging software for short-term rentals](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-guest-messaging-software-short-term-rentals) , and for inspections or a dedicated cleaning tool, our[Breezeway alternatives](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/breezeway-review-pricing-alternatives) and Turno alternatives.


## How much do HostBuddy alternatives cost?


Two of the seven HostBuddy alternatives publish a per-listing price. Aeve charges $12.80 per listing per month on a 12-month contract, with up to 15 listings at a flat $192 a month. Conduit publishes $18 per unit per month for Messaging, $30 for Guest, $36 for Guest + Devices, and $48 for Full Suite with tasks and dispatch, plus a Startup plan at $899 a month for 0-25 units; those are starting rates, and pricing scales beyond 50 listings. Hospitable has a free Essentials plan, but its paid figures did not render. Hostaway says AI Replies has no add-on fee, though the PMS price isn't published, and Akia, Besty, and Guesty don't publish prices.


HostBuddy offers a 14-day free trial and prices by property count. If messaging is the whole job and your team handles calls and tasks without strain, staying on HostBuddy will likely cost less than any platform here. Switching pays when your team spends much of its day turning flagged messages into tasks and relaying updates to guests.


## FAQ


The questions below are the ones operators ask most when comparing HostBuddy AI alternatives for vacation rentals, covering phone AI, task management, how cautious each autopilot is, and what each one costs where the vendor publishes a price. Each answer stands on its own.


### What is the best alternative to HostBuddy AI?


The best HostBuddy AI alternative depends on the gap you need to close. Akia, Besty, and Conduit add phone AI and task management to guest messaging, Aeve adds policy-locked replies and field scheduling on Guesty or Hostaway, and Guesty, Hospitable, and Hostaway build the AI into the PMS.


### Does HostBuddy AI answer phone calls?


HostBuddy AI does not publish an AI voice or phone agent as of October 2026. It handles written guest messaging through your PMS and its Smart Inbox, and flags issues for your team through Action Items.


### Does HostBuddy AI have task management?


HostBuddy AI does not include a task management module. It flags messages that need follow-up, such as maintenance issues and lockouts, as Action Items, and your team creates and assigns the work.


### Which HostBuddy alternative is closest in approach?


Besty and Aeve are closest to HostBuddy's cautious approach. Besty's Autopilot sends only when confident and pauses on negative sentiment, and Aeve keeps replies within the policies you set and hands everything else to a person.


### Which HostBuddy alternatives publish pricing?


Aeve publishes $12.80 per listing per month on a 12-month contract, and Conduit publishes $18 to $48 per unit per month depending on the package. Hospitable has a free tier, and Hostaway says AI Replies has no add-on fee. Akia, Besty, and Guesty do not publish prices.


### Can I use HostBuddy and a task management tool together?


HostBuddy works alongside the task tools in PMSs like Guesty, Hospitable, and Hostaway, because it connects to your PMS. The trade-off is that a person still turns each Action Item into a task and tells the guest when it's done.
